```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Step 1: inner_join to get only participants with BOTH species + metadata (~800)
combined <- metadata_diabete %>%
  mutate(
    BMI = DBI14_Weight / (DBI13_Height / 100)^2,
    BMI_category = case_when(
      BMI < 18.5                ~ "Underweight",
      BMI >= 18.5 & BMI < 23   ~ "Normal",
      BMI >= 23   & BMI < 27.5 ~ "Overweight",
      BMI >= 27.5               ~ "Obese",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    diabetes_status = case_when(
      DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent < 5.7                               ~ "Normal",
      DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent >= 5.7 & DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent < 6.5 ~ "Prediabetic",
      DLAB27_Hba1C_Percent >= 6.5                              ~ "Diabetic",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    BMI_category    = factor(BMI_category, levels = c("Underweight", "Normal", "Overweight", "Obese")),
    diabetes_status = factor(diabetes_status, levels = c("Normal", "Prediabetic", "Diabetic"))
  ) %>%
  inner_join(species_filtered1, by = "FREG1_Barcode")  # only matched samples

cat("Total matched samples:", nrow(combined), "\n")
table(combined$BMI_category, useNA = "ifany")
table(combined$diabetes_status, useNA = "ifany")


# Step 2: Metabolically healthy subset for sensitivity analysis
# Definition: Normal BMI (18.5–22.9) AND normoglycemic (HbA1c < 5.7%)
metabolically_sensitive <- combined %>%
  filter(
    BMI_category != "Obese",
    diabetes_status != "Diabetic",
    # exclude NAs so you don't accidentally retain unclassified participants
    !is.na(BMI_category),
    !is.na(diabetes_status)
  )

cat("Sensitivity subset N:", nrow(metabolically_sensitive), "\n")
table(metabolically_sensitive$FREG5_Ethnic_Group)
table(metabolically_sensitive$BMI_category, useNA = "ifany")
table(metabolically_sensitive$diabetes_status, useNA = "ifany")
```

##redo alpha beta DA
```{r}
# ── 0. Prepare sensitivity subset ─────────────────────────
# Exclude Obese, Diabetic, and ethnic O
meta_sensitive <- metabolically_sensitive %>%
  filter(FREG5_Ethnic_Group != "O") %>%
  mutate(FREG5_Ethnic_Group = droplevels(factor(FREG5_Ethnic_Group)))

sensitive_barcodes <- meta_sensitive$FREG1_Barcode

# Subset and align species matrix (samples as rows)
abund_sensitive <- species_sensitive %>%
  filter(FREG1_Barcode %in% sensitive_barcodes) %>%
  column_to_rownames("FREG1_Barcode")

# Ensure row order matches between meta and abund
meta_sensitive <- meta_sensitive %>%
  filter(FREG1_Barcode %in% rownames(abund_sensitive)) %>%
  arrange(match(FREG1_Barcode, rownames(abund_sensitive)))

# Add Participant_ID column (used as rownames in phyloseq)
meta_sensitive <- meta_sensitive %>%
  mutate(Participant_ID = FREG1_Barcode)

cat("Sensitivity N:", nrow(meta_sensitive), "\n")
table(meta_sensitive$FREG5_Ethnic_Group)


# ── 1. Phyloseq object ─────────────────────────────────────
OTU_s  <- otu_table(t(abund_sensitive), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
META_s <- sample_data(meta_sensitive %>% column_to_rownames("Participant_ID"))
ps_sensitive <- phyloseq(OTU_s, META_s)

sensitive_colors <- c("C" = "#9FDDCA", "I" = "#9EA3F1", "M" = "#E17887")


# ── 2. Alpha diversity ─────────────────────────────────────
p_alpha_s <- plot_richness(ps_sensitive,
              x        = "FREG5_Ethnic_Group",
              color    = "FREG5_Ethnic_Group",
              measures = c("Shannon", "Simpson")) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = FREG5_Ethnic_Group), alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sensitive_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = sensitive_colors) +
  stat_compare_means(
    method      = "kruskal.test",
    label       = "p.format",
    label.x     = 1.5,
    label.y.npc = 0.95
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons   = list(c("C","I")),
    method        = "wilcox.test",
    label         = "p.signif",
    step.increase = 0.08
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "right",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Ethnicity", color = "Ethnicity", fill = "Ethnicity",
       title = "Alpha diversity — sensitivity analysis (excl. Obese & Diabetic)")

p_alpha_s
ggsave("figure/alpha_metabolic_healthy.pdf",
       plot = p_alpha_s, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)


# ── 3. Beta diversity ──────────────────────────────────────
bc_dist_s <- vegan::vegdist(abund_sensitive, method = "bray")

abund_clr_s     <- t(apply(abund_sensitive, 1, clr_transform))  # reuse clr_transform from before
aitchison_dist_s <- dist(abund_clr_s, method = "euclidean")

# PERMANOVA
perm_bc_s  <- vegan::adonis2(bc_dist_s       ~ FREG5_Ethnic_Group, data = meta_sensitive, permutations = 999)
perm_ait_s <- vegan::adonis2(aitchison_dist_s ~ FREG5_Ethnic_Group, data = meta_sensitive, permutations = 999)
print(perm_bc_s)
print(perm_ait_s)

# PCoA plots — reuse plot_pcoa() but pass sensitive_colors
plot_pcoa_s <- function(dist_obj, dist_name, meta) {
  pcoa_obj <- ape::pcoa(dist_obj)
  var_exp  <- round(pcoa_obj$values$Relative_eig[1:2] * 100, 1)
  df <- data.frame(
    PC1       = pcoa_obj$vectors[, 1],
    PC2       = pcoa_obj$vectors[, 2],
    Ethnicity = meta$FREG5_Ethnic_Group
  )
  perm_obj <- vegan::adonis2(dist_obj ~ FREG5_Ethnic_Group, data = meta,
                            permutations = 999, by = "terms")
  r2  <- round(perm_obj["FREG5_Ethnic_Group", "R2"], 3)
  pv  <- perm_obj["FREG5_Ethnic_Group", "Pr(>F)"]
  lab <- paste0("PERMANOVA: R²=", r2,
                ", p=", ifelse(pv < 0.001, "<0.001", round(pv, 3)))
  ggplot(df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Ethnicity)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = sensitive_colors) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.5,
             label = lab, size = 3.2, color = "grey30") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Beta diversity — ", dist_name, " (sensitivity analysis excl. Obese & Diabetic)"),
      x     = paste0("PC1 (", var_exp[1], "%)"),
      y     = paste0("PC2 (", var_exp[2], "%)")
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}

p_bc_s  <- plot_pcoa_s(bc_dist_s,        "Bray-Curtis", meta_sensitive)
p_ait_s <- plot_pcoa_s(aitchison_dist_s,  "Aitchison",  meta_sensitive)

p_bc_s
p_ait_s
ggsave("figure/beta_metabolic_bc.pdf",
       plot = p_bc_s, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("figure/beta_metabolic_ait.pdf",
       plot = p_ait_s, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# ── 4. DA analysis (LinDA, one-vs-rest) ────────────────────
meta_sensitive <- meta_sensitive %>%
  mutate(
    C_vs_rest = ifelse(FREG5_Ethnic_Group == "C", "C", "non-C"),
    I_vs_rest = ifelse(FREG5_Ethnic_Group == "I", "I", "non-I"),
    M_vs_rest = ifelse(FREG5_Ethnic_Group == "M", "M", "non-M")
  )

run_linda_s <- function(group_var, label) {
  res <- linda(
    feature.dat  = t(abund_sensitive),
    meta.dat     = meta_sensitive %>% column_to_rownames("Participant_ID"),
    formula      = paste0("~ ", group_var),
    alpha        = 0.05,
    p.adj.method = "BH",
    prev.filter  = 0.10
  )
  contrast_name <- names(res$output)[1]
  res$output[[contrast_name]] %>%
    rownames_to_column("Species") %>%
    mutate(contrast = label) %>%
    filter(reject == TRUE) %>%
    arrange(padj)
}

res_C_s <- run_linda_s("C_vs_rest", "C vs non-C")
res_I_s <- run_linda_s("I_vs_rest", "I vs non-I")
res_M_s <- run_linda_s("M_vs_rest", "M vs non-M")

cat("C vs non-C:", nrow(res_C_s), "\n")
cat("I vs non-I:", nrow(res_I_s), "\n")
cat("M vs non-M:", nrow(res_M_s), "\n")

sig_all_s <- bind_rows(res_C_s, res_I_s, res_M_s)
print(sig_all_s %>% select(Species, log2FoldChange, padj, contrast))
```

```{r}
library(ggrepel)
# ── 1. Extract FULL results (all species, not just sig) ────
extract_linda_full <- function(group_var, label, focal) {
  res <- linda(
    feature.dat  = t(abund_sensitive),
    meta.dat     = meta_sensitive %>% column_to_rownames("Participant_ID"),
    formula      = paste0("~ ", group_var),
    alpha        = 0.05,
    p.adj.method = "BH",
    prev.filter  = 0.10
  )
  contrast_name <- names(res$output)[1]
  res$output[[contrast_name]] %>%
    rownames_to_column("Species") %>%
    mutate(
      contrast = label,
      sig      = reject == TRUE & !is.na(padj)
    )
}

df_C_full <- extract_linda_full("C_vs_rest", "C vs non-C", "C")
df_I_full <- extract_linda_full("I_vs_rest", "I vs non-I", "I")
df_M_full <- extract_linda_full("M_vs_rest", "M vs non-M", "M")

cat("C sig:", sum(df_C_full$sig), "\n")
cat("I sig:", sum(df_I_full$sig), "\n")
cat("M sig:", sum(df_M_full$sig), "\n")


# ── 2. Updated plot_volcano (sensitivity labels) ───────────
plot_volcano <- function(df, focal_group) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_padj = pmin(-log10(padj), 10),
      label_species  = ifelse(sig, Species, NA),
      dot_color = case_when(
        sig & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "red3",
        sig & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "steelblue",
        TRUE                     ~ "grey80"
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neg_log10_padj,
                 label = label_species)) +
    
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid",
               color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
    
    geom_point(aes(color = I(dot_color),
                   size  = sig,
                   alpha = sig)) +
    scale_size_manual(values  = c("TRUE" = 2.8, "FALSE" = 1.2), guide = "none") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 0.9, "FALSE" = 0.4), guide = "none") +
    
    geom_text_repel(
      data          = df %>% filter(sig),
      size          = 3,
      max.overlaps  = Inf,
      box.padding   = 0.8,
      point.padding = 0.5,
      force         = 10,
      force_pull    = 0.5,
      segment.color = "grey50",
      segment.size  = 0.3,
      fontface      = "italic",
      direction     = "both"
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title    = paste0("Differential abundance: ", focal_group,
                        " vs non-", focal_group),
      subtitle = paste0("Sensitivity analysis (excl. Obese & Diabetic) · LinDA · BH-corrected  |  ",
                        sum(df$sig & df$log2FoldChange < 0),
                        " enriched in ", focal_group, "  ·  ",
                        sum(df$sig & df$log2FoldChange > 0),
                        " depleted in ", focal_group),
      x        = paste0("Log2 fold change (negative = enriched in ", focal_group, ")"),
      y        = expression(-log[10](p[adj]))
    ) +
    
    scale_color_identity(
      guide  = "legend",
      labels = c("red3"     = paste0("Enriched in ", focal_group),
                 "steelblue" = paste0("Depleted in ", focal_group),
                 "grey80"   = "Not significant"),
      breaks = c("red3", "steelblue", "grey80")
    ) +
    
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "right",
      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key       = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)
    ))
}


# ── 3. Plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_volcano_C_s <- plot_volcano(df_C_full, "C")
p_volcano_I_s <- plot_volcano(df_I_full, "I")
p_volcano_M_s <- plot_volcano(df_M_full, "M")

p_volcano_C_s
p_volcano_I_s
p_volcano_M_s
```

```{r}
plot_lollipop <- function(df, focal_group, top_n = 30) {
  
  df_sig <- df %>%
    filter(sig) %>%
    mutate(
      log2FoldChange = -log2FoldChange,   # flip sign
      direction = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0,   # enriched is now positive
                         paste0("Enriched in ", focal_group), 
                         paste0("Depleted in ", focal_group)),
      Species = gsub("_", " ", Species),
      Species = factor(Species, levels = Species[order(log2FoldChange)])
    )
  
  if (nrow(df_sig) > top_n) {
    df_sig <- df_sig %>%
      arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
      slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
      arrange(log2FoldChange) %>%
      mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = Species))
    subtitle_note <- paste0("Top ", top_n, " by |log2FC| shown")
  } else {
    subtitle_note <- paste0(nrow(df_sig), " significant species")
  }
  
  ggplot(df_sig, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = Species, color = direction)) +
    
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
    
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = log2FoldChange,
                     y = Species, yend = Species),
                 linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
    
    geom_point(aes(size = -log10(padj)), alpha = 0.9) +
    
    scale_color_manual(
      values = setNames(
        c("red3", "steelblue"),
        c(paste0("Enriched in ", focal_group), paste0("Depleted in ", focal_group))
      )
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name   = expression(-log[10](p[adj])),
      range  = c(2, 6),
      breaks = c(2, 4, 6, 8)
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title    = paste0("Differential abundance: ", focal_group, " vs non-", focal_group),
      subtitle = "Sensitivity analysis (excl. Obese & Diabetic) · LinDA · Top 30",
      x        = paste0("Log2 fold change (positive = enriched in ", focal_group, ")"),
      y        = NULL,
      color    = NULL
    ) +
    
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey90"),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 9, face = "italic"),
      legend.position    = "right"
    )
}

# ── Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_lollipop_C_s <- plot_lollipop(df_C_full, "C", top_n = 30)
p_lollipop_I_s <- plot_lollipop(df_I_full, "I", top_n = 30)
p_lollipop_M_s <- plot_lollipop(df_M_full, "M", top_n = 30)

p_lollipop_C_s
```
